title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Just Crossed a Disappointing Milestone
content:
Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has just crossed a disappointing milestone with its hiatus as the manga is currently showing no signs of return after a full year. Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has been an absolute powerhouse ever since the manga first made its debut in the pages of Shogakukan’s Weekly Shonen Sunday magazine in 2020, and that’s been even more the case with the success of its official TV anime adaptation . Unfortunately, it’s been a while since fans have seen new chapters of the manga hit the magazine.

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End had announced it would be going on an indefinite hiatus following the release of Chapter 147 on October 14th in Japan last year , and unfortunately it’s been a full year without any new updates on the next chapter of the series. This is an unfortunate milestone for the manga release, but also makes fans worry even more for series creators Kanehito Yamada and Tsukasa Abe as the two of them went on hiatus for health concerns.

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Hiatus Has Now Lasted Over a Year

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End originally confirmed it would be going on an indefinite hiatus last year due to health concerns for its creators, but has yet to reveal any potential update for its return. The manga has had a number of hiatuses and extended breaks through its tenure thus far, and even had a hiatus last for a few months last year before it went on hiatus again in October . It’s been a bumpy road for the fans keeping up with the manga, and it’s gotten even more eyes in the last few years thanks to the anime bringing in more fans.

Even with Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End being on this extended hiatus, however, the manga is still topping sales charts in Japan . Though this has been far from the only hiatus for the series, and is currently the longest one of its serialization yet, the story has been so appealing to fans that they are still supporting it in any way they can. That’s even more true as with new episodes of the anime now in the works for a release next year, even more potential fans are going to seek out the manga to see what’s next.

When Does Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 3 Come Out?

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is currently scheduled to make its debut sometime next October as part of the Fall 2027 anime schedule. The new season will have a returning production staff and cast with Tomoya Kitagawa returning as director for Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 3 for Madhouse with Tomomi Suzuki handling the composition , Maru Takase and Keisuke Kojima providing the character designs, and Evan Call composing the music. It’s also going to be taking on the biggest arc of the series to date with this coming season.

Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 3 will be adapting The Golden Land Arc which fans got small teases of during the second season. The new season will be introducing Macht, who is currently hailed as the strongest of the Seven Sages of Destruction . Macht has yet to be officially cast as of this time, but you can catch up with everything that’s happened in the anime thus far now streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime.

Can you believe Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has been on hiatus for a year? Are you taking this time to catch up? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Singer AKINO Graduates from bless4; Band Changes Name to 'bless∞(Forever)'
content:
AKINO has been with Bless4 for 24 years.

AKINO debuted with her brothers Akashi and AIKI and her sister Kanasa in the band Bless4 , with the single "Good Morning! Mr.Sunshine." AKINO made her solo debut with the " Genesis of Aquarion " and "Go Tight" singles for the Genesis of Aquarion anime, both composed by Yōko Kanno . She has since then performed several songs for anime, including Oban Star-Racers , and Kantai Collection - Kan Colle - , Active Raid , and Amagi Brilliant Park , as well as games such as Final Fantasy XIV .

The band, which included four siblings from the Japanese American Kawamitsu family, debuted in Japan in 2003. They have contributed songs to the Disney-produced anime Stitch! , Izetta: The Last Witch , and The Ancient Magus' Bride . AIKI left the band in 2022 to focus on family and his solo career. Originally from Phoenix, AZ, the band members live in Kawasaki, and have performed in Korea and released songs in Europe.

title: Bleach Announces Special Livestream Ahead of Anime Finale
content:
Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is going all out for the anime’s grand finale as it has announced it will be hosting a special livestream to help usher in the final episode’s premiere. Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity officially returned to screens after a month long hiatus for the first of its final two episodes ever . With the penultimate episode bringing the fight against Yhwach to its end after over a decade of fans waiting to see it brought to life, it’s time to see how the anime brings it all to an end.

It’s been 22 years since Bleach first made its anime adaptation debut , and the long running anime franchise will finally be coming to an end with the release of its final episode coming next week. To help emphasize just how big of a moment this is going to be, Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity has announced a special livestream event leading up to the final episode’s premiere in Japan where the staff will go behind the scenes about everything leading up to it.

Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War to Host Livestream for Final Episode’s Premiere

As part of a special pre-screening livestream for Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 50 on October 25th in Japan, series creator Tite Kubo will be attending the event alongside members of the anime’s production staff as they share behind the scenes stories and more exclusive information to help commemorate the release of the anime’s final episode. It’s not clear exactly what they’re going to showcase during the event, but it’s certainly another great way to get excited for the final episode to come. It’s time to get ready for it at last.

As for when fans will be able to check out the final episode of the series, the Japanese language version of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War – The Calamity Episode 50 will be releasing on October 26th at 8:30AM PT with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+. The penultimate episode of the anime is currently available to watch there as well along with all of the other episodes so far, but the English dubbed versions of the final two episodes are set for a later date with Episode 49 debuting on November 23rd at 8:30AM PT followed by Episode 50 on November 30th at 8:30AM PT.

What to Know for Bleach ‘s Final Episode?

Not much has been revealed about Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Episode 50 beyond its release date, and it’s hard not to see why as the anime has made all sorts of changes to Kubo’s manga version of the finale through all of the episodes seen thus far. There are only one and a half chapters of the manga to adapt with the final episode, and it’s an epilogue story that reveals Ichigo’s life years after the fight against Yhwach . Which means it’s going to be the first time all of these time skip designs will be animated in full.

The final epilogue is plenty to adapt in the anime as is without any additional materials needed for the final episode, but there could likely be all sorts of surprises that fans would have never expected to see. It’s no mystery why this final episode has been kept as such a secret , and now it’s time to see if Bleach fans will be happy with the final after waiting two decades for it to end. What are you hoping to see in Bleach ‘s final episode ever? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Simpsons Secretly Recasts a Missing Character With Their Return After 6 Years
content:
The Simpsons has made waves with some big returns in the most recent episode of Season 38, and fans might not have noticed that another character has been secretly recast. The Simpsons surprised fans with a new Treehouse of Horror Presents special this past weekend , and with it kept the surprises going even further by fully bringing back Apu to the series with a new voice actor in tow. But he wasn’t the only recast snuck into the episode, however, as there are two others that have been changed going forward.

The first of which is Apu’s wife Manjula, who also makes her r eturn to the series with the latest episode of The Simpsons Season 38 . Now voiced by Janina Gavankar ( The Morning Show ), she’s been brought back to the series alongside Apu and the Kwik-E-Mart as a recurring setting. But the wilder return also snuck into the episode has been Dr. Nick, who is now back in the series and voiced by Eric Lopez following Hank Azaria’s time with the role.

Dr. Nick Returns With New Voice Actor in The Simpsons Season 38

The Simpsons Season 38 “Treehouse of Horror Presents: The Revengening” largely takes place outside of the main series’ canon and within Apu’s nightmare, but it’s a way for the series to address Apu’s absence and recasting after not speaking in the series for nearly a decade. As The Simpsons is now more careful to have its voice stars reflecting the race of characters in the animated series, fans have seen many of the other characters being recast over the years such as Carl, Dr. Hibbert, Bumblebee Man and more. In the case of Bumbleeman, his former voice actor is now behind Dr. Nick as well.

Eric Lopez took over as the voice of Bumblebee Man beginning with The Simpsons Season 32 episode, “Now Museum, Now You Don’t” before being later replaced by Humberto Vélez (who famously voices Homer Simpson in the Spanish dub of the series) last year. But the latest episode now sees Lopez in the role of Dr. Nick, who was also voiced by Hank Azaria. In the wake of other changes for Azaria’s role with Apu and other characters , it seems he has further stepped back from taking on characters of other races in the time since.

What Does This Mean for Dr. Nick in The Simpsons ?

But unlike Apu’s return that certifiably puts him back into the main canon of The Simpsons by the end of the episode, it’s a little more unclear for Dr. Nick’s case. His last speaking appearance under Azaria came during Season 31’s “Warrin’ Priests Part 2” in 2020, but he’s not exactly a character that had the same amount of prominence that Apu did before his own disappearance . He jokes in the episode that he’s been relegated to an island of forgotten gag for “eight seasons,” but the timeline for his actual appearance has been murky because of his being on the lower end of priorities.

Now that he’s been officially recast, it’s likely that The Simpsons is going to be able to use him for more of the quick gags that Dr. Nick was famous for in his previous appearances. But because he was reintroduced during this non-canon moment as a throwaway joke noting the fact he was basically forgotten, this also could be a joking goodbye. Are you hoping to see more of Dr. Nick in The Simpsons future? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: A-DO Manga to End on November 18
content:
The November issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Young Magazine announced on Tuesday that Jaku Amano 's A-DO manga will end in its next chapter in the magazine's next issue on November 18.

The series entered a hiatus in October due to the author's poor physical health, but resumed on February 19.

The manga's 11th compiled book volume reported in July 2025 that the series will end with its 12th volume. The 12th volume shipped on July 17, but the manga is still continuing.

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Following a wave of immigration, Japan has became a volatile mix of people and cultures, rocked by the protests of xenophobic extremists unhappy with the new status quo. A brash, job-hopping young woman named Riko is driving her scooter through one such protest when she sees a boy about to get run over by a truck. Riko just manages to shove him out of the way, and, in the hours that follow, she finds herself looking after the boy, named Eito. Riko takes Eito out for a bowl of ramen, but just as they're about to dig in, Eito is fired upon by a distant army sniper. As the bullet pierces the restaurant window and comes whizzing toward Eito, plant-like tendrils snake out from his arm and stop it in mid-flight. Who in the world is this boy, and why is the army after him?!

Amano launched the manga in Monthly Young Magazine in June 2019. Kodansha USA Publishing shipped the 10th volume in English on September 8.

title: Firefly Wedding's Oreko Tachibana Launches New Manga in Winter
content:
The 13th and final compiled book volume of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding ( Hotaru no Yomeiri ) manga announced on Monday that Tachibana will launch a new manga in Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app this coming winter. The preview teases the manga as centering on two powerful leaders who are at odds and must never fall in love: the prince of a country of men, and the chief of a country of women.

Viz Media publishes the Firefly Wedding manga in English, and it describes the story:

On the surface, Satoko has it all—she's beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family's eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

Tachibana launched the manga on the Manga ONE app in January 2023, and ended it on February 2. Tachibana also drew seven spinoff chapters, releasing once every month, from February 2 to August 3. The first two chapters were titled "Koi to Doku." The latter five chapters were titled "Hitokiri to Yōdō." The chapters were compiled into the spinoff volume, which released on the same day as the main manga's 13th volume on Monday. Viz Media released the eighth volume in English on October 13.

The manga is inspiring an ongoing television anime that debuted on October 9 and airs on Fuji TV 's Noitamina programming block that airs on Fridays at 11:30 p.m. Crunchyroll is streaming the series as it airs. The manga is also inspiring a live-action television adaptation that is slated to debut in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Orient's Shinobu Ohtaka Launches New Manga
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app announced on Tuesday that manga creator Shinobu Ohtaka will launch a new manga titled Geek and Crown ( Geekrown ) on October 27. The announcement teases that the story will center on a treasonous military officer in the middle of a succession crisis.

Ohtaka ( Magi ) launched the Orient manga in Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine in May 2018. The manga moved to Kodansha 's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine in February 2021. The manga entered its final arc in July 2023, and ended in October 2024. Kodansha published the manga's 22nd and final compiled book volume in November 2024. Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and released the 20th volume on April 14.

The first cours (quarter of a year) of the manga's anime adaptation premiered in Japan in January 2022. Crunchyroll streamed the anime, and also streamed an English dub . The anime's second cours premiered on TV Tokyo in July 2022, and covered the "Awajishima Gekitō-hen" (Fierce Battle at Awaji Island Arc) of the original manga. Crunchyroll also streamed the anime's second cours , and an English dub .

title: Go! Go! Loser Ranger! Manga Goes on Hiatus Again Due to Creator's Health
content:
This year's 47th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine announced on Wednesday that Negi Haruba 's Go, Go, Loser Ranger! ( Sentai Daishikkaku ) manga is going on hiatus due to Haruba's health. The announcement did not reveal when the manga will resume.

The series previously entered a hiatus on July 8, and only recently returned last month on September 24.

The manga entered its final arc on March 18 earlier this year, when it returned from a month-long hiatus.

Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the series:

When the Monster Army invaded Earth thirteen years ago, the Divine Dragon Rangers rose up to stop them! With the war raging on, these great heroes are mankind's last hope! ...or are they? In truth, the invaders were subjugated within a year, forced to continue to crank out a monster a week for the Rangers to crush in front of their adoring fans! But one monster has had enough. Something has to change! He'll rebel against the might of the Dragon Rangers and destroy them all...from the inside!

Haruba ( The Quintessential Quintuplets ) launched the ongoing manga in Weekly Shōnen Magazine in February 2021.

The manga inspired a television anime . The first season premiered on the TBS channel and 27 of its affiliates in April 2024. The anime is available worldwide on Disney+ (and on Hulu in North America). The second season premiered in April 2025. Disney+ again streamed the anime.

contentBlocks.text: This year's 47th issue of Kodansha 's Weekly Shōnen Magazine announced on Wednesday that Negi Haruba 's Go, Go, Loser Ranger! ( Sentai Daishikkaku ) manga is going on hiatus due to Haruba's health. The announcement did not reveal when the manga will resume.
The series previously entered a hiatus on July 8, and only recently returned last month on September 24.
The manga entered its final arc on March 18 earlier this year, when it returned from a month-long hiatus.
Kodansha USA Publishing is releasing the manga in English, and it describes the series:

When the Monster Army invaded Earth thirteen years ago, the Divine Dragon Rangers rose up to stop them! With the war raging on, these great heroes are mankind's last hope! ...or are they? In truth, the invaders were subjugated within a year, forced to continue to crank out a monster a week for the Rangers to crush in front of their adoring fans! But one monster has had enough. Something has to change! He'll rebel against the might of the Dragon Rangers and destroy them all...from the inside!
Haruba ( The Quintessential Quintuplets ) launched the ongoing manga in Weekly Shōnen Magazine in February 2021.

The manga inspired a television anime . The first season premiered on the TBS channel and 27 of its affiliates in April 2024. The anime is available worldwide on Disney+ (and on Hulu in North America). The second season premiered in April 2025. Disney+ again streamed the anime.

title: Eleceed TV Anime's English-Subtitled Trailer Reveals April 2027 Delay
content:
The official website for the television anime of author Jeho Son and artist ZHENA 's webtoon series ELECEED started streaming the anime's English-subtitled trailer, and announced its April 2027 premiere on Wednesday.

Amuse Creative Studio had originally announced a 2026 premiere for the anime.

The anime's YouTube channel describes the story:

Hidden in the shadows of the modern world, there exist associations and organizations of people known as the “Awakened” — those who possess superhuman abilities. High schooler Jiwoo Seo knows nothing of this world, living in fear while hiding his own mysterious power. Then one day, after he nurses an injured stray cat back to health, Jiwoo's world is turned upside down. "Let go of me already, you fool!!" The battered stray cat — which should never have been able to talk — suddenly speaks?! The stray cat turns out to be Kayden, the strongest of the Awakened, transformed by mysterious means. Unable to return to his human form, Kayden begins living with Jiwoo... Jiwoo, who never felt he could become anything, and Kayden, the solitary, unrivaled Awakened,are soon drawn into the organizations and conspiracies of the Awakened world. Led by a cat. Bound for greatness. Can the two of them change the world—?

The anime will star:

• Junya Enoki as Jiwoo Seo (listed as Yuu Kazahaya in the above promo video), a reeserved young man who avoids involvement with others

• Tasuku Hatanaka as Wooin (listed as Jin Tatsuoka in the above promo video), a mysterious Awakened who transfers into Jiwoo's class

• Setsuji Satō as Dr. Delein, a brilliant scientist consumed by his relentless pursuit of research

• Hayato Dojima as Jisuk Yoo (listed as Sota Yanagi in the above promo video), a hot-headed Awakened student who attends the same school as Jiwoo

• Shizuka Itō as Jiyoung Yoo (listed as Amane Yanagi in the above promo video), "the young leader of 'Mythos,' one of the largest Awakened organizations in Japan."

Hiroshi Nishikiori ( IDOLiSH7 the Movie LIVE 4bit BEYOND THE PERiOD , Honey Lemon Soda ) is directing the anime at DandeLion Animation Studio ( The First Slam Dunk ). Yousuke Kuroda ( My Hero Academia ) is writing and overseeing the series scripts. Minami Sakura ( Gridman Universe ) is the character designer.

Additional staff members include:

• Sub-Character Design: Masato Katō, Mina Ōsawa, Kōji Watanabe

• Assistant Director: Miyuki Wakai

• Chief Animation Supervisors: Minami Sakura, Masato Katō

• Art Director: Mayu Imaichi

• Color Design: Haruko Nobori

• Director of Photography: Yūjirō Yamane

• Special Effects: Miyako Hoshi

• CG Supervisor: Takeshi Shimizu

• Editor: Shigeru Nishiyama

• Sound Director: Takatoshi Hamano

• Music: Taku Iwasaki

Since its debut in 2018, ELECEED has been serialized in over 10 languages, including English, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, French, and Spanish. It remains a consistent top performer on NAVER WEBTOON's battle-action charts in North America, Asia, and Europe. The series has surpassed 1.7 billion views globally.

Son's Noblesse received a television anime adaptation by Production I.G in 2020. A previous 30-minute Noblesse: Awakening OAV released in 2016. Crunchyroll streams both anime.

title: Grotesqqque Anime Film Previews Song by Junna, yutori's Kotoko Satō
content:
The official website for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) confirmed on Wednesday that the film will feature the song "ZUKIZUKI" as performed by JUNNA and the yutori rock band's vocalist Kotoko Satō , two music contributors for the "Yoroshiku★Girl" short story. Yuyoyuppe , another music contributor for "Yoroshiku★Girl," wrote the lyrics as well as scored and arranged the music. The song is now available on various music services, and the website also started streaming the song's collaboration music video with the film:

The film is an omnibus film of three stories with different worldviews.

• "A(E)liens"

• "Yoroshiku★Girl," (also known as "4649 Girl," pronounced as "Yoroshiku★Shōjo," a pun on the words "Nice to Meet You★Girl" with the literal meaning of the kanji being "Evening Dew Heads to Its Death★Girl." The numbers 4649 can be read in Japanese as "Yoroshiku.")

• "Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque" ("Nocturne: Kono Grotesque na Yoru ni," literally, Nocturne: On This Grotesque Night, romanized in a previous video as "Nocturn: En Cette Nuit Grotesque.")

The film's cast members and characters include :

For the "A(E)liens" story:

• Kana Ichinose as Ellie

• Gen Hoshino as Kento Kurikura

• Akio Ōtsuka as Space Agency Bureau Director

For the "Yoroshiku★Girl" story:

• Sara Minami as Stella

• Ikumi Hasegawa as Unknown (Nanashi)

• Saori Hayami as Hikarin

• Maaya Uchida as Gorgeous Mika

• Chika Anzai as Sword

• Miyu Tomita as Chiffon

• Rumi Ōkubo as Papico

• Rie Kugimiya as Poyomi

For the "Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque" story:

• Nagi Inoue (from Nogizaka46) as Ayame

• Aruno Nakanishi (from Nogizaka46) as Shion

• Miku Ichinose (from Nogizaka46) as Momo

• Nao Tomisato (from Nogizaka46) as Canna

The 35 musical acts contributing to each story in the film are:

"A(E)liens:"

• Mika Ichinose

• VaVa

• Ken Kamikita

• sabio/Fūta Takamura

• SEE

• Surii

• Taku Inoue

• tsumiki

• Yūshi Nakajima (from Gusokumuzu)

• Nanahira

• Hashimero

"Yoroshiku★Girl"

• ASCA

• Akki

• -otoha-

• Kotoko Satō (from yutori)

• Kanon Shizaki

• Ayato Shinozaki

• JUNNA

• Suisō

• Ryōsuke Tachibana

• Shiina Natsukawa

• Iori Noguchi (from =LOVE)

• Shōta Horie (also known as kemu)

• Myuk

• MIRI

• Rei Yasuda

• Yuyoyuppe

• Runaar

• Reol

"Nocturne: Nuit Grotesque"

• eba

• Nakano+

• Kairi Yagi

Atsushi Nishigori ( The IDOLM@STER , DARLING in the FRANXX ) is directing the film, and is also writing the screenplay and designing the characters.

The band METALVERSE performs the opening theme song "Shoot Shoot Shoot." Haoto performs the ending theme song with lyrics by momosu momosu.

The film comes from JOEN , the company jointly established by Sony media subsidiary Aniplex , its CloverWorks animation studio, Production I.G sister company Wit Studio , and publisher Shueisha . CloverWorks producer Yūichi Fukushima and Wit Studio producer Tetsuya Nakatake are the representative directors of JOEN .

The film will open in Japan on November 6. The film's "Yoroshiku★Girl" segment will stream early for a limited time on Netflix in Japan from October 23 to November 5.

The film had its world premiere at this year's Fantasia International Film Festival , which took place in Montreal from July 16-August 2. The Japan Society host the U.S. premiere of the film in collaboration with CloverWorks and Aniplex of America in New York City on October 8. Director Nishigori gave a pre-screening introduction in-person at the event.
